name: @spiky-panda/plugin-spectroscopy
description: Spectroscopy plugin for SpikyPanda: a LIBS forward model. A plasma node turns an elemental composition into a list of atomic line emissions, a spectrometer node samples that list onto a pixel grid with a slit function, a calibration, a gain and reproducible noise, and keeps the ideal, instrumented and measured curves separate. Emission intensities are RELATIVE at this version: the built-in line catalogue is unverified, and the physical Boltzmann / Saha model refuses to run rather than return a number.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run compile
